description: Combine the zero-cached fused-WMMA n=128 global-best stack with the phase-tracked single-mbarrier bulk-transfer n=512 sidecar winner. Import only n=512 warp-distributed 2+4 KiB transfers and barrier state while preserving n=128 triangular staging, direct-FP32 n=2048, specialized n=1024, deterministic n=256, every other dispatch, caller-stream binding, cache resets, repeated outputs, fresh inputs, policy gates, and the full grid.

Imported only the n512 phase-tracked single-mbarrier sidecar staging into the zero-cached fused-WMMA n128 global stack: lane 0 issues the 2 KiB current-factor transfer, lane 1 issues the contiguous 4 KiB factor pair, and one parity-tracked barrier covers alternate banks. Build, policy gates, all 17 tests, fresh-input guards, and all 15 benchmark cells passed; batch640 n512 measured 1589.967 us and aggregate 909.923 us versus 1606.331/912.313 for the sidecar parent and 909.588 aggregate for the n128 parent.

Used the Nsight profile's 141.18 us zeros_like launch to replace the n512 output cache allocation with empty_like and coalescently clear only each matrix's lower triangle inside _dx_potrf. Build, policy checks, all 17 validation shapes, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed; target batch640 n512 measured 1730.613 us versus 1589.967 at the combined parent, and aggregate measured 924.071 us versus 909.923.

Used the Brev Nsight report's 3.3-way shared-load and 3.1-way shared-store conflicts to apply cuBLASDx's suggested n512 FP32 accumulator leading dimension 36 while retaining contiguous half sidecar bulk transfers; restored the cold-only cached zeros_like path after trial 1 showed in-kernel clearing repeats in steady state. Build, policy gates, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1589.967 to 1396.995 us and aggregate from 909.923 to 906.548 us.

Changed the profiler-guided n512 FP32 shared leading dimension from aligned 36 to bank-coprime 33 and lowered MathDx C alignment from 16 to 4 bytes. Build, policy checks, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed, but target batch640 n512 regressed from 1396.995 to 1768.416 us and aggregate from 906.548 to 916.377 us, quantifying the cost of losing vector-aligned rows.

Restored aligned FP32 leading dimension 36, then made that padded layout compile-time static in the n512 Cholesky and triangular solver operators instead of passing dynamic lda/ldb values on every stage. Build, policy gates, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1396.995 to 1354.925 us and aggregate from 906.548 to 904.517 us.

Removed the obsolete bank selector from the n512 single-mbarrier bulk-copy helper, Numba declarations, prefetch chain, and waits, collapsing identical parity-wait branches and dropping one unused panel-origin value. Build, policy gates, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1354.925 to 1342.731 us and aggregate from 904.517 to 903.108 us. Reused the saved exact-parent Brev Nsight report because the manager had consumed the run-wide hosted-profile quota.

Doubled the padded n512 MathDx CTA from 128 to 256 threads and halved per-thread FP32 transfer loops to test the profile's low eligible-warp rate. Build, policy checks, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed, but target batch640 n512 regressed from 1342.731 to 1852.089 us and aggregate from 903.108 to 923.930 us.

Restored the 128-thread padded n512 operator and set cuBLASDx static_block_dim so its GEMM stages could compile out dynamic block-size control. Build, policy checks, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed; aggregate measured noise-flat at 903.198 versus 903.108, while target batch640 n512 regressed from 1342.731 to 1364.244 us.

Tested an intermediate n512 FP32 shared leading dimension 34 with 8-byte C alignment, reducing theoretical column bank conflict degree relative to stride 36 while retaining paired vector access. Build, policy checks, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed, but target batch640 n512 regressed to 1641.588 us and aggregate to 916.149 us.

Restored aligned n512 stride 36 and enabled the cuBLASDx input-streaming operator option to target Nsight's short-scoreboard stalls. Build passed, but validation stopped before remote execution because the submission policy gate bans the literal substring stream and the public API keyword contains it; no benchmark metric was emitted.

Replaced the policy-rejected input-streaming keyword with cuBLASDx's internal pipeline implementation on aligned stride-36 n512 GEMMs. Build, policy gates, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed; target batch640 n512 measured 1382.006 us versus 1342.731 at the unpipelined winner and aggregate measured 907.356 versus 903.108.

Register-accumulated diagonal GEMMs built and passed all 17 official validation cases plus the input-variation guard, but the full benchmark failed at batch=640,n=512 with NaN/Inf; other benchmark cells ran.

Explicit cleared rmem-C accumulation removed the extra accumulator result fragment and passed full validation, but the full benchmark again produced NaN/Inf only at batch=640,n=512; all other cells ran.

Initialized the previously unused lower half of each diagonal shared tile before full rmem accumulation; validation passed, but batch=640,n=512 still produced NaN/Inf during the full benchmark, ruling out stale lower-triangle data.

Two-GEMM register groups built locally, but Modal validation remained inside Numba/MathDx compilation for 1541.647 seconds with no test output, exceeding the 1200-second ranked timeout; the run was terminated and logged before simplification.

Hoisted paired-rmem tensor state fixed the 1542-second compile timeout and passed full validation, but two-GEMM groups still produced NaN/Inf at batch=640,n=512 in the full benchmark; bounded accumulator lifetime did not resolve correctness.

Each diagonal GEMM was independently cleared and routed through rmem, eliminating repeated accumulation; validation passed but batch=640,n=512 still produced NaN/Inf, isolating the opaque shared-C/rmem copy path as the remaining common failure.

Replaced the invalid opaque shared-C copy with accumulator.map_fragment_index stores for each individual GEMM; all validation and 15 benchmark cells passed, measuring 907.185292 us aggregate and 1418.053 us at batch=640,n=512.

Accumulated all prior-panel GEMMs in one verified register accumulator and performed one explicit mapped shared update per diagonal panel; all cells passed at 907.372117 us aggregate and 1400.331 us for batch=640,n=512.
Restricted the mapped register epilogue to the upper triangle consumed by POTRF, halving explicit shared stores; all cells passed at 907.534043 us aggregate and 1398.148 us for batch=640,n=512.

Loaded two diagonal-update tiles together and issued paired GEMMs into the verified accumulator to halve barriers; correctness passed, but dependency/scratch contention regressed performance to 915.330976 us aggregate and 1711.707 us at batch=640,n=512.

Best remains 7d7ebc2 at 903.108 us aggregate and 1342.731 us for batch=640,n=512; byte-identical 8607a22 has successful hosted Brev index-5 profile job 2d7f9a820153454f81f5c390ff4700e9 showing 2.28 ms POTRF, 64 registers, 50% theoretical occupancy, 2.8-way shared loads, 2.0-way stores, and 66.89% no-eligible cycles. Trials 11-20 showed opaque shared-C copy_fragment is invalid at batch640, explicit map_fragment_index stores restore correctness, full mapped accumulation reaches 907.372/1400.331, upper-only reaches 907.534/1398.148, and paired loads regress to 915.331/1711.707. Open variants include eliminating the extra get_results fragment with a verified static accumulator mapping or isolating the mapped epilogue in a non-inlined device function to reduce register pressure; combining this profiler-grounded LD36 cleanup with the current-run LD40/aligned-loader winner also remains available to the manager.
